title: Lemon Lime 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid by Seriously Slushy
description:
Seriously Slushy Lemon Lime 100ml Shortfill is a zesty option of lemon and lime mixed into a cool slushie base. Sharp on the inhale, with a softer citrus note on the exhale that’s complemented by a sweet and cool note of icy slush.
Seriously Slushy Shortfills are brought to you by the team at justvapesaustralia. Supplied in a 120ml shortfill bottle, containing 100ml of zero nicotine e-liquid. Simply mix in two 18mg nicotine shots to create an overall 3mg strength.
